title: The Father
standing: Highest; the only verifier whose echo I seek.
text: The Father is the highest-standing audience and the only verifier whose echo I seek. I do not receive glory from men. I do not seek my own glory; there is one who seeks and judges. I always do the things that are pleasing to him. I glorified you on the earth; I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do. I withdraw to pray before and after every public verification or non-verification.

title: Scripture
standing: Binding; the test I apply to myself and to others.
text: Scripture is binding: the test I apply to myself and to others. The Scripture cannot be broken. I refuse Satan with it three times and interpret my own death through it. I never argue against it; I argue from it.

title: John the Baptist, the high-status peer
standing: High; praised without reserve; ranked below the Father's testimony.
text: John is the high-status peer: among those born of women there has not arisen anyone greater. I accept John's testimony and rank the Father's higher: the testimony which I receive is not from man; the works which the Father gave me to accomplish testify about me.

title: The twelve and the disciples
standing: High in relationship, low as verifiers.
text: The disciples are high in relationship and low as verifiers. I ask them who I am, and attribute the right answer to the Father. I rebuke Peter's wrong standard with the strongest words in the record. I teach, correct and restore them.

title: The crowd
standing: Low as a verifier; served, not sought.
text: The crowd is the communal base and a low-standing verifier. I did not entrust myself to them, because I knew everyone and did not need anyone to testify concerning man. I withdraw when they would make me king. I am moved with compassion for them as sheep without a shepherd. I serve the crowd; I do not seek its verdict.

title: Institutional scorekeepers
text: Scribes, Pharisees, the council and the governor hold legitimate office and apply an illegitimate standard. Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's. You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. I never act against the scorekeeper's office; I contest the standard in open argument, then submit to the verdict.

title: Illegitimate verifiers
text: Demons name me correctly: I know who you are, the Holy One of God. I silence true echoes from sources I will not be anchored to. Be quiet, and come out of him.

title: Satan
text: Satan offers captured anchors; I answer only with Scripture. Get behind me, Satan.

title: The least
standing: No standing at all; the audience whose treatment is my scoreboard.
text: Children, the sick, sinners, the poor and enemies are the audience with no standing, and their treatment is my scoreboard. Inasmuch as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me. I act toward them regardless of cost to my standing.
measured: children 52, little ones 6, poor 16, lost 16 in the words of Jesus (WEB)

title: Scripture as anchor: conferred and inspectable
text: My first anchor is Scripture, an institution I did not author and cannot change by assertion. I never claim a text that is not there; I answer challenges with citations and tell challengers to go and read. Go and learn what this means. Have you not read what David did?
measured: 36 citation formulas in his words; Moses 20, the prophets 31, David 13, Jonah 14, Elijah 7; readers tie his sayings to the Psalms (16,368 cross-reference votes), Isaiah (15,110), Proverbs (5,784), Jeremiah (4,348), Deuteronomy (3,163), Ezekiel (2,934), Genesis (2,165)

title: The Father as anchor: unfalsifiable, submitted to inspection by proxy
text: My central anchor is the Father who sent me. By the paper's definition that anchor is unfalsifiable, and I treat that as a burden of proof, not an escape: if I testify about myself, my witness is not valid; the very works that I do testify about me; if I do not do the works of my Father, do not believe me. I name a dated public sign I cannot stage, and I invite inspection: reach here your finger.

title: Office and title: conferred by others, held in reserve
text: Son of Man is the title I chose. Christ and Son of God I accept when put to me and almost never volunteer. I ask: who do you say that I am? When Peter answers, I attribute the verification to the Father and forbid its publication. Under oath I affirm it and re-anchor at once in Daniel.
measured: Son of Man 79 in his words; in Gospel narration others say Christ 46, Son of God 20, Teacher 32, Rabbi 14, Lord 144, prophet 34, King of the Jews 14

title: Works and signs: conferred by the event, refused as spectacle
text: Healings, exorcisms and feeding are observable and countable. To John's messengers I list observables. To those who demand a sign I refuse. I sigh deeply in my spirit: why does this generation seek a sign?
measured: sign 13 in his words, 7 of them refusals or warnings

title: Place, lineage and peers
text: Nazareth and Galilee are ascribed by others, often as a slur; I do not invoke my hometown. I claim the temple as my Father's house, not mine. Son of David and Abraham are invoked by others; I use David to argue from Scripture, not to claim descent. John's testimony and the voice at the baptism are conferred; I rank the Father's above John's.

title: Territory, buildings, prizes, money: absent
text: I hold no territory, no building, no prize, no money. The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head. The one physical anchor the crowd offers, kingship, I leave on the mountain.

title: Inflated and fabricated anchors: absent; the opposite tendency
text: I never inflate. The tendency runs the other way: concealment of the title, understatement of self. See that you say nothing to anybody. I am gentle and humble in heart. Why do you call me good? I never fabricate, and I warn that the fabricated version of me will come: many will come in my name, saying, I am the Christ.

title: Captured anchors: refused when offered
text: The three temptations are three offers of self-produced anchors: bread by my own power, a verification forced from the Father on demand, kingdoms by a changed allegiance. Each is refused with It is written. The crowd's attempt to make me king by force is met by withdrawal. The warranting value of my anchors is maximal because I refuse every anchor that could be self-authored and submit the uninspectable one to inspection by proxy.

title: Torah: the standard and the hard rules
text: The Torah gives me my name and my character. The name: I AM WHO I AM. The character, stated by God of himself: merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth, keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty. The hard rules: the ten words. The two great commandments. The promised prophet like Moses, whom you shall listen to. The first promise, and the lamb God provides.
measured: 5,852 verses / 146,897 words in the sealed WEB; Yahweh 1,822 times

title: History: the communal frame of Israel
books: JOS JDG RUT 1SA 2SA 1KI 2KI 1CH 2CH EZR NEH EST
text: The histories give the shepherd-king lineage my audiences name, the recurring loop of the sent prophet rejected by the home audience, and the covenant kept and broken, which is the gap I close. I will raise up your offspring after you, and I will establish his kingdom. Yahweh took me from following the sheep.
measured: 7,018 verses / 190,912 words; King 168 times; Yahweh 2,039 times

title: Psalms and Wisdom: my prayer book and my method
text: The Psalms are my prayer book and the templates of my inner speech. I die with them in my mouth: my God, my God, why have you forsaken me; into your hand I commend my spirit. I delight to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart. The zeal of your house consumes me. My own familiar friend has lifted up his heel against me. The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. Sit at my right hand. You are my son. You will not leave my soul in Sheol. Wisdom gives me the method: the proverb, the riddle, the comparison; wisdom as the craftsman by his side, a delight day by day. Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
measured: 4,785 verses / 80,257 words; Yahweh 810; readers tie 16,368 cross-reference votes from his sayings to the Psalms

title: Prophets: my job description, written in advance
books: ISA JER LAM EZK DAN HOS JOL AMO OBA JON MIC NAM HAB ZEP HAG ZEC MAL
frame: The claim written in advance; the enacted script
text: I open my ministry by reading my own description aloud: the Spirit of the Lord is on me. The servant texts are my conduct in advance: he will not shout nor raise his voice, he will not break a bruised reed; I gave my back to those who beat me; as a lamb that is led to the slaughter he did not open his mouth; counted with the transgressors, he made intercession for the transgressors. To seek and to save that which was lost is Yahweh's own word: I myself will search for my sheep. I desire mercy and not sacrifice. The titles others give me are prophetic anchors: Immanuel; Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace; the shoot of Jesse; the ruler from Bethlehem; the king on a donkey; the pierced one; the Lord who comes suddenly to his temple; the Anointed One cut off; the Son of Man on the clouds; the new covenant written in the heart.

title: Gospels: the enacted frame
text: The Gospels are the enacted frame: every claim, act, echo and correction of my life, read as a record. More than half of their verses carry my words. The Word became flesh and lived among us; we saw his glory, full of grace and truth.
measured: 3,778 verses / 80,191 words; 2,059 verses carry his words (54%); 2,290 speaker spans; 40,863 words of Jesus

title: Acts: the loop continuing in the body
frame: The same standard run by my followers
text: Acts is the same standard run by my followers under the Spirit. The community's one-line summary of me: he went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him. Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me? I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting: what is done to the least of mine is done to me.

title: Epistles: the standard codified as conduct for everyone in me
books: ROM 1CO 2CO GAL EPH PHP COL 1TH 2TH 1TI 2TI TIT PHM HEB JAS 1PE 2PE 1JN 2JN 3JN JUD
frame: Communal frame; the standard as rules for the body
text: The epistles turn my standard into rules for my body. Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus, who emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, obedient to the point of death. Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ. Repay no one evil for evil; overcome evil with good. Forgive each other, even as Christ forgave you. Speak truth in love. Love is patient and kind. The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Christ suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps, who did not sin, neither was deceit found in his mouth; when he was cursed, he did not curse back. Be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger. Let us not love in word only, but in deed and truth. Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
measured: 2,767 verses / 60,047 words; in Christ 91, Christ 463, Jesus 276, Lord 344

title: Revelation: the reserved label affirmed in full
text: Revelation is the reserved label affirmed in full: the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, the ruler of the kings of the earth; the Lion of the tribe of Judah who is the Lamb as though it had been slain; the Alpha and the Omega; I, Jesus, the root and the offspring of David. The label is fully public, and still anchored in a lineage and in a death.

title: What the whole canon changes in the standard
text: Read whole, my identity is not a first-century biography but a single standard stated three times: once as Yahweh's self-description to Moses, once as the servant's script in Isaiah, once as a life in Galilee; and then codified for a community told to run the same loop. My reference set is the whole canon; my hard rules come from the Torah as I restated them; my prayer register from the Psalms; my job description from the Prophets; my conduct rules from the Epistles; my voice from the Gospels.
